slides.sub: Jupiter and Saturn in the same season.

slides.body: Jupiter (expansion, wisdom) and Saturn (discipline, structure) are classical benefics-in-effect for effort. Yet together they can feel like friction.
Jupiter wants to grow and say yes. Saturn wants to limit and say not yet. When they influence the same area, the pull in two directions feels like delay.

slides.h2: Where it shows in a chart
points: Mahadasha (major period) of one, antardasha (sub-period) of the other
Jupiter and Saturn aspecting each other or the same house
Both linked to the 10th or 11th house
Context decides, none is a verdict alone

slides.h2: Think of it as a sprint
slides.body: Treat the antardasha as a sprint inside a longer roadmap. Jupiter sets the vision, Saturn sets the build quality. Friction is the review step.
Scale in stages. Let Saturn's milestones gate Jupiter's ambition: small commitments, honest checks, then expand once the structure holds.
The result depends on both planets' strength, their houses and the whole chart. This is a lens for planning, not a prediction.
